regions.text: 可能性を表はす弧が矢の方向に増大した極限は必然性を表はす圓間となる。

quote.translation: When the arc representing possibility increases in the direction of the arrow, its limit is the circumference representing necessity.

regions.text: 弧が次第に減少して矢の方向と反勤にSが限りなくSに近づき、直線SSが隈りなく直線STに近づき返にその極限として直線SSが直線STに合しgがSに合した場合に、偶然性としてのSが浮出て來るのである。

quote.translation: When the arc decreases, on the other hand, S′ moves against the direction of the arrow and approaches S without end, and the line SS′ approaches the line ST without end, until, at the limit, SS′ coincides with ST and S′ with S, and it is then that S emerges as contingency.

regions.text: 換言すれば偶然性は不可能性を表はす切線STが可能性を表はす曲線に接する切動としてのSである。

quote.translation: In other words, contingency is S, the point at which the tangent ST, representing impossibility, touches the curve representing possibility.

regions.text: 偶然性は不可能性の直線上に位置を有つてゐる無に近いものである。

quote.translation: Contingency, having its position on the straight line of impossibility, is something close to nothingness; and just as the negation of the circumference is the point, contingency is the negation of necessity.

regions.text: さうして囲間の否定が點である如く、偶然性は必然性の否定である。また圓周上にS點以外に無限數の切點が思催せられる如く偶然性は離接約なる可能性の統盤の一離接肢に過ぎない。

quote.translation: Again, just as an infinite number of points of tangency other than S can be thought on the circumference, contingency is no more than one disjunct within the totality of disjunctive possibility.

regions.text: しかも偶然性は自己が生産點たることを自覺するや極徴的可能性より出發して曲線を連續に充實し途に可能性を必然性の画間にまで展開し得る現實の力である。

quote.translation: Yet contingency, once it becomes aware that it is itself the producing point, is the force of the actual that sets out from infinitesimal possibility, fills out the curve continuously, and can finally unfold possibility as far as the circumference of necessity.

regions.text: 偶然性は、可能性をして偶々可龍なる感女の可能性より常に可能なる母の可能性へ自覺せしめる迫力である。

quote.translation: Contingency is the driving force that brings possibility to awareness, leading it from the virgin possibility of what is possible by chance to the maternal possibility of what is always possible.

regions.text: 偶然性は、現實の一點に脆くも尖端的存在を繋ぐだけであるが、實在の生産原理として全生産活動を擔ふの情熱を有つたものである。

quote.translation: Contingency merely fastens, frailly, an existence at its extreme point to a single point of the actual, but as the productive principle of reality it has the passion to bear the whole of productive activity.
